Build more, together: the INERIM partnership program

INERIM works with architects, developers, dealers and contractors as a supply, pasting and execution partner.

Architects & interior designers

You design it, and we make and install it the way you drew it.

  • Custom cabinets, wardrobes & furniture made to your drawings
  • HPL, acrylic & laminate supply with finish samples
  • Site measurement and installation by our team
  • One point of contact for production updates

Developers & real estate

Interior packages for show flats and handovers that help units sell.

  • Package-based interiors for repeat unit types
  • Show-flat design, 3D visualisation and execution
  • Consistent specifications across buildings
  • Coordinated scheduling with your site team

Material dealers & retailers

Add finishing materials and pasting services to your own range.

  • HPL, acrylic & laminate sheet supply
  • HPL / acrylic board pasting service
  • Decorative panels & louvers
  • Aluminium profile handles & glass profile frames

Contractors & carpenters

Ready-pasted boards, profiles and hardware so your team builds faster.

  • Board pasting with a clean, inspected finish
  • Profile handles, glass frames and brass strips
  • Help choosing finishes for your clients
  • Material sourcing for project-based work

How to become a partner

  1. Apply online
  2. Intro meeting
  3. First order or project
  4. Ongoing partnership
